name: Destructo-Bot: the bot's bar survives the built pet's death (#10093)

Mechano-Bear 803405 (60671) switched the action bar back to the Tinker's, so the bot could not self-destruct.

names a unit (its low guid word is non-zero) instead of the cleared bar.
